svg.title: About me: Product Design & UI/UX — From problem framing and user flows to polished, high-fidelity interfaces for web and mobile products.; Design Systems & DesignOps — Components, tokens and variables, plus the documentation and processes that help teams build consistently at scale.; UX Research & IA — Interviews, synthesis and information architecture that turn messy problems into clear structures.; AI & Design Engineering — AI-assisted workflows and design-to-code: HTML prototypes, agents and tooling that close the gap between design and build.
